title: Lovely Filipino Egg Omelette
description: A crispy and flavorful omelette featuring free-range eggs and a hint of mustard, reminiscent of traditional Filipino cuisine. This dish is perfect for a quick and satisfying breakfast or snack.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt and pepper until the whites and yolks are fully incorporated.
Heat a small non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the softened butter, letting it melt and coat the bottom of the pan.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Pour the whisked eggs over the onion and garlic mixture, letting them cook until the edges start to set.
Add the prepared mustard to one half of the omelette and use a spatula to gently fold the other half over the top.
Cook for an additional minute, until the eggs are almost fully set and the omelette is crispy on the bottom.
Use the spatula to carefully slide the omelette out of the skillet and onto a plate, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
